answer: A farm running 107 keys hence pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the ferrous stake is held until the raven settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the crystal audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 25% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
